headline: US proposes tariffs up to 20 percent on 14 trading partners including China EU and India
label: NEWS
caption:
The United States has unveiled plans for major new trade duties on key international partners 🚨

The US administration has proposed new tariffs of up to 20 percent on 14 trading partners, according to senior US officials cited by Dawn.

The proposed duties target major economies including China, the European Union, India, Japan, and South Korea after a months long probe into excess production capacity.

A senior US official said the measures come over allegations that these economies promote production divorced from market demand, adding that the duties could take effect in January at the earliest.

The announcement also includes proposed additional tariffs on goods from Brazil, including aircraft, over alleged trade concerns.
